evidence.statement: Vanilla Lua defines the color rectangle primitive and forwards to its vanilla UI object.
Vanilla Lua defines the color rectangle primitive and forwards to its vanilla UI object.
Native background/border calls use full widget bounds; fade, pressed, icon and input lifecycle stay native.
Native slider clamps/snaps currentValue and suppresses doOnValueChange when ignoreOnChange is true.
Native slider invokes its callback with target, value and the slider instance.
Text entry invokes its registered callback with target and entry.
Vanilla Lua getter forwards to its existing text box object.
Vanilla Lua method forwards the maximum text length to its existing text box object.
displayBackground gates native backing; borderColor alpha controls native focused border.
titleLeft and font/textColor govern the native label position and rendering.
Vanilla menu label height and labels use exposed UIFont.Large.
Both front-end and in-game MainScreen create large-font ISLabel navigation with native internal IDs, callbacks and bottomPanel ownership; native layout measures and sizes the labels.
Native construction assigns UITransition fade and MainScreen.prerenderBottomPanelLabel to navigation labels.
Native label prerender updates fade and draws the old grey hover rectangle before delegating to ISLabel; hover/controller transition and audio are managed separately.
Native callbacks register menu construction on OnMainMenuEnter and OnGameStart, with OnResetLua restoring state; an adapter registered after requiring the module can decorate the completed instance.
Native controller rows refer to label identities and activate the same native menu action callback; instance rendering need not replace those labels or controller methods.
Native action callback guards delay/tutorial/save checks and quit cooldown before native exit actions. The adapter only reads those guards for visual state.

Native label prerender draws translated/name text, preserves controller A glyph behavior and updates the existing tooltip. Temporary text/color fields can be restored after delegation without changing action identity.
setCapture(bool) forwards capture ownership to the vanilla UI element; actual native dispatch remains a runtime gate.
Stock moveWithMouse updates parent when a child is dragged; the editor uses owned callbacks instead.
Out-of-game keyboard events reach the instance onKeyRelease handler; the instance wrapper leaves global dispatch intact.
Native front-end modal code uses JoypadState.getMainMenuJoypad and updateJoypadFocus; ordinary A/Y actions are delegated.
restoreJoypadFocus explicitly highlights the selected child after panel focus assignment.
Native slider buttons consult isShiftKeyDown and select the larger shift step; no editor key binding is installed globally.

addChild attaches the native/Lua child and may duplicate ordered entries if repeated; removeChild unregisters the child but does not clear its parent field. Owned editor attachment is idempotent and explicit teardown clears the root parent.
Vanilla Lua uses Keyboard.KEY_F10 as a key constant; the editor handles it only through its owned main-menu instance.
MainScreen owns an initially hidden full-screen MainOptions child, constructed before native settings create.
Native page wrappers own scroll/controller and stencil setup/cleanup; create builds tabs and Back/Accept/Apply controls.
Native Apply owns game/mod option persistence, monitor confirmation and restart/reset prompts; close restores menu/controller focus.
Native focus/buttons/tab bumpers and Escape/Return remain authoritative, with popup guards.

evidence.symbol: ISTabPanel rendering and tab hit geometry
evidence.statement: Native render draws selected textures for both active tabs and inactive hover overlays, uses clipping/overflow arrows and measures native Small-font headers.

evidence.symbol: ISComboBox shared popup ownership and rows
evidence.statement: Shared popup checks parentCombo visibility, draws its border and uses parentCombo hover/text colours for row rendering.
A class-shared popup receives current font/owner, enters UIManager and captures input; settings colours must be temporary and owner-guarded.
Native options, disabled rows, joypad focus and check textures retain their native row metrics; the adapter preserves font/layout.
Native volume bar uses ten-step geometry and setVolume callback; settings only tint its drawing.
The native extended volume control retains its own geometry and value/callback behavior.
Native slider consumes button/bar/thumb fields and sliderMouseOverColor during drag; interaction geometry remains native.
Native input uses static background/border drawing and keyboard focus; settings retain these methods and fonts.

evidence.symbol: ISSliderPanel cached pagination and owned hit geometry
evidence.statement: paginate caches height in thumb/bar geometry; setWidth paginates before an inherited later setHeight. Owned editors must paginate after final bounds. Native value/input methods remain authoritative.
addPage builds a scrolling stencil-enabled native page and changes mainPanel/addY; the additive Interface page restores those root construction pointers.

evidence.symbol: Player data creation and layout restore
evidence.statement: Player-backed HUD construction is unsafe in the frontend. Native window registration restores geometry during creation; local overrides apply afterward. Primary native layout registration does not establish secondary-player runtime correctness.
Native createPlayerData rebuilds active player UI and registers creation/resolution callbacks. Adapter requires the module before its own hooks and bounds scans to four current local UI slots.
RegisterWindow calls TryRestore synchronously. UI does not edit layout.ini or manager private tables; native ordinary persistence may retain geometry after overrides are released.
resizeFunction(target,width,height) receives absolute requested dimensions after native restrictions; generic setWidth/setHeight is used only without that callback.

updateLayout computes content-dependent width. createChildren line138 sets resizeWidget.yonly; constructor lines1504-1519 uses width800/minimumHeight600. The adapter preserves width and exposes height only.
setSizeAndPosition derives slot width and centers the bar; update invokes it repeatedly. An owned current-instance post-delegate applies only an explicit saved position without changing native width.
Minimap prerender calls setPosition. Explicit userPosition selects the user-origin path with native clamping; no generic width/height resizing is inferred.
Native resize widgets retain chat layout callbacks/minima. Chat construction requires player/session state and is never invoked by the frontend preview.

evidence.symbol: Clock reads do not prove mutation
evidence.statement: Observed clock geometry access is read-only evidence. Mutable Clock/Moodles geometry remains UNKNOWN, so frontend samples are reference-only.

evidence.symbol: ISPanelJoypad child focus clear/restore for confirmation
evidence.statement: Panel focus transfer alone does not clear focused descendants. clearJoypadFocus explicitly clears each selected child; restoreJoypadFocus re-highlights the current child when Keep editing returns.
Analog update checks the slider own joyfocus and joypadFocused fields rather than the root focus owner. Editor confirmation clears underlying child focus before taking controller input.

create resets native key metadata and constructs/attaches a new tabs panel. addPage248–270 targets that panel and installs scrolling/controller/stencil behavior. Observation of tabs readiness is separate from native repeat-build cleanup guarantees.

Native MainScreen allocates Options and later calls create at694. Another provider may defer that construction; the source-only native event order alone is insufficient proof of ready tabs at attachment time.

Native selection clears expanded and removes shared captured popup before onchange. hidePopup alone does not clear expanded. Per-instance guards preserve another combo popup and consume dismissal gesture; exact engine click-through remains NOT TESTED.

Native down arms pressed; up/outside-up consume/reset it; double-click routes through down. forceClick is separate controller activation. Owned HUD buttons preserve delegates and require a matching safe pointer down.

evidence.symbol: Fixed canvas local coordinates and capture
evidence.statement: Widget getMouseX/Y are local (absolute offset/own scroll subtracted). Fixed canvas input uses native callback local coordinates and pointer deltas, not moving-frame positions. setCapture is an exposed Lua delegate.
Installed vanilla Lua calls global isMouseButtonDown(0/1/2). HUD canvas uses left-button state to clear lost capture/dismissal guard without timers.

Vanilla tests UIManager.getUI():contains(ISComboBox.SharedPopup.javaObject) separately before switching pages. HUD editor requires that registration plus exact popup/parentCombo/expanded ownership before treating a captured dropdown as owned input. Whether global isModalVisible includes capture is UNKNOWN from inspected Lua; simultaneous foreign modal is a runtime gate.
